name: hypoxia
description: Bulk RNA-seq, human cells in vitro, hypoxia vs normoxia. Gold: included GSEs of Puente-Santamaria et al. (2022) Biomedicines 10(9):2229 (silver standard: positives only).

protocol.intent: Bulk RNA-seq datasets of human cells cultured in vitro that compare hypoxia (reduced oxygen) with normoxia, for a meta-analysis.
protocol.query: hypoxia[Description] AND "expression profiling by high throughput sequencing"[DataSet Type]

criteria.text: The dataset contains bulk RNA-seq expression profiling (not only single-cell RNA-seq, not only ChIP/ATAC/other non-expression assays).
The dataset includes human cells cultured in vitro (cell lines or primary cells).
Cells were exposed to hypoxia or anoxia by reduced oxygen tension (not only chemical hypoxia mimetics such as DMOG, CoCl2 or FG-4592, and not only intermittent/cyclic hypoxia).
The design includes a normoxia or baseline-oxygen control condition to compare against hypoxia.
